veranderings.voor: Werkers skep steenkool in die vuur en die water kook
veranderings.na: Werkers skep steenkool in die vuur, en die water kook
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Die waens dra mense en die trokke
veranderings.na: Die waens dra mense, en die trokke
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: dra die gewig en die wiel sak nie weg nie
veranderings.na: dra die gewig, en die wiele sak nie weg nie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma between two full clauses, and plural 'wiele' to match the previous sentence's 'n Trein se wiele'.

veranderings.voor: hou die trein ook op een pad
veranderings.na: hou die trein ook op koers
veranderings.rede: 'op een pad' is vague; 'op koers' is the natural idiom for keeping something on its course.
The sentence means the oxen could not move the load, so the modal 'kon' is needed.
A railway line 'is geopen'; 'het oopgemaak' follows the English 'the line opened'.
The two sentences before have 'lyn' and 'Mense' as subjects, so 'hy' is a distant reference; naming him is clearer.
In a past-tense narrative 'toe' is more natural than 'nou' for 'from then on'.
AWS: no comma before 'en' when what follows has no subject and verb of its own.
'op een slag' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; 'in een keer' is a Dutch-style calque.
